nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, $H^d_n$ denotes the space of homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$, including the zero polynomial.
nodes.title: Homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$

nodes.summary: For a homogeneous polynomial $f$ of degree $2$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$, its Hessian is the real $n \times n$ matrix $\mathcal{H}_f$ of second partial derivatives of $f$: the diagonal entry $(i, i)$ is twice the coefficient of $w_i^2$ in $f$, and for $i \ne j$ the entry $(i, j)$ is the coefficient of $w_i w_j$ in $f$.
nodes.title: Hessian of a quadratic form

nodes.summary: A subset $J \subseteq \mathbb{N}^n$ is M-convex if for all $\alpha, \beta \in J$ and every index $i$ with $\alpha_i > \beta_i$ there is an index $j$ with $\alpha_j < \beta_j$ and $\alpha - e_i + e_j \in J$, where $e_1, \dots, e_n$ are the standard unit vectors of $\mathbb{N}^n$.
nodes.title: M-convex sets

nodes.summary: A polynomial $f \in \mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$ is stable if either $f$ is the zero polynomial or $f(z_1, \dots, z_n) \ne 0$ for all $z_1, \dots, z_n$ in the open upper half plane $\mathbb{H} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Im} z > 0\}$.
nodes.title: Stable polynomials

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, the set $L^d_n$ of Lorentzian polynomials is a set of homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$, defined by recursion on $d$. For $d \le 2$, $L^d_n = S^d_n$, the set of homogeneous stable polynomials of degree $d$ with nonnegative coefficients. For $d \ge 3$, $L^d_n$ is the set of $f \in M^d_n$ (the homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$ with nonnegative…
nodes.title: The set of Lorentzian polynomials

nodes.summary: $M^d_n$ is the set of homogeneous polynomials $f$ of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$ whose coefficients are all nonnegative and whose support, the set of exponent vectors $\alpha \in \mathbb{N}^n$ of the monomials with nonzero coefficient in $f$, is M-convex.
nodes.title: Homogeneous polynomials with M-convex support

nodes.summary: $P^d_n$ is the set of homogeneous polynomials $f$ of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$ such that the coefficient in $f$ of every monomial of degree $d$ is strictly positive.
nodes.title: Homogeneous polynomials with positive coefficients

nodes.summary: $S^d_n$ is the set of homogeneous polynomials $f$ of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$ whose coefficients are all nonnegative and that are stable: either $f$ is the zero polynomial or $f$ has no zero in $\mathbb{H}^n$, where $\mathbb{H}$ is the open upper half plane in $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Stable homogeneous polynomials with nonnegative coefficients

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n \ge 1$ and $d$, the closure of the set $\mathring{L}^d_n$ of strictly Lorentzian polynomials of degree $d$ in $n$ variables, taken in the space $H^d_n$ of homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$ with the Euclidean topology on coefficients, is the set $L^d_n$ of Lorentzian polynomials of degree $d$ in $n$ variables.
nodes.title: Lorentzian polynomials as the closure of strictly Lorentzian polynomials

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $d$, the set $\mathring{L}^d_n$ of strictly Lorentzian polynomials of degree $d$ in $\mathbb{R}[w_1, \dots, w_n]$ is defined by recursion on $d$. Let $P^d_n$ be the set of homogeneous polynomials of degree $d$ in which every monomial of degree $d$ has a strictly positive coefficient, and let $\partial_i$ be the partial derivative with respect to $w_i$. Then $\mathring{L}^0_n = P^0_n$ and…
nodes.title: Strictly Lorentzian polynomials

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
